recovery.title: Recover access
recovery.explanation: Confirm your device security to choose a new PIN and keep your conversations. Unlocking the screen alone does not complete this check.
recovery.waiting: Complete verification in the device system window.
recovery.cancel_notice: Cancelling keeps your PIN and conversations.
recovery.choose_instructions: Choose four digits from 0 to 9 and repeat them. Your previous PIN works until the new one is saved.
recovery.verified_notice: Device security was verified. Choose a new PIN to access your saved conversations.
recovery.failed: Device security could not be verified. Your previous PIN and conversations have been kept.
recovery.unavailable: Device recovery is unavailable on this device. Sign in with your previous PIN.
recovery.expired: This confirmation has expired. Start a new device verification.
recovery.cancelled: Recovery was cancelled. Enter your previous PIN.
recovery.replace_key_notice: Your PIN, chats and drafts are kept. The current API key stays in place until the new key is checked and saved.
recovery.protection_notice_android: Forgotten PINs can be recovered with a separate device security check.
recovery.protection_notice_other: Keep your PIN safe. Device recovery is unavailable on this platform.
recovery.protection_notice_android_unava: Device recovery is unavailable here. Keep your app PIN safe.
recovery.linux_explanation: Confirm your Linux account in the system window to choose a new PIN and keep your conversations. Tokenlogue never asks for your Linux password.
recovery.linux_waiting: Complete verification in the Cinnamon system window.
recovery.linux_setup: System recovery needs separate setup. See the Linux recovery guide. Your PIN and conversations are kept.
recovery.linux_watch_ready: Screen lock and sleep lock Tokenlogue. Sign in again to continue.
recovery.linux_watch_unavailable: Automatic locking is limited. Lock Tokenlogue manually before leaving.
recovery.linux_policy_missing: System recovery has not been set up. See the Linux recovery guide. Your PIN and conversations are kept.
recovery.linux_policy_unsafe: System recovery could not be verified. Ask for help checking its setup. Your conversations stay locked.
recovery.linux_session_unavailable: Return to your unlocked Linux desktop and try again.
recovery.linux_authorization_unsafe: A new system confirmation is required. Ask for help checking recovery setup. Your data is kept.
recovery.linux_agent_unavailable: The system confirmation window is unavailable. Check the Linux recovery guide and try again.
recovery.linux_transport_unavailable: System recovery is unavailable. Try again or see the Linux recovery guide. Your PIN and conversations are kept.
recovery.lock_cancels_change: Locking the device cancels an unfinished PIN change. Your previous PIN works until the new one is saved.
